Request a Demo Court Case Management for Airlines Experience effortless collaboration and workflow efficiencies with justcourts.eu See also our solution for passenger claims management Features of our legal case management solution justcourts.eu Efficient Case Management 01 Efficient Case Organization ​ Easily categorize and organize legal cases according to type, client, or other criteria. Quickly access case details, including documents, deadlines, and contact information. Streamline the process of initiating, assigning, and tracking tasks related to each case. Save costs with workflow automation ​ Automate repetitive administrative tasks. Reduce the need for manual data entry and paperwork, saving valuable time. Minimize the risk of costly errors and oversights in case management. ​ Save time with document automation Save time by automatically generating fully drafted and branded legal documents through the use of an online form that automatically pushes the provided data into text templates. Enhanced Productivity Empower your legal team to work more efficiently by providing them with a centralized platform for case management. Enable real-time collaboration and information sharing among team members. Efficient Information Sharing Facilitate the sharing of insights, case progress, and critical updates instantly, promoting a cohesive and productive team environment. 02 03 Security and Data Privacy Robust Data Encryption Benefit from state-of-the-art encryption protocols to ensure that all your sensitive legal documents and information are securely stored and transmitted. Role-Based Access Control Implement role-based access control to restrict access to confidential data, ensuring that only authorized personnel can view or edit specific documents. Audit Trails and Compliance Maintain comprehensive audit trails and adhere to regulatory compliance standards to track all user activity and demonstrate your commitment to data protection. User-Friendly Interface Intuitive Navigation Navigate the software effortlessly with an intuitive user interface designed for ease of use. There's no steep learning curve, making it accessible to all team members as well as your outside legal counsel. Quick Implementation Get your legal practice up and running with minimal delay, as our user-friendly interface requires little to no extensive training. Effortless Adoption Encourage widespread adoption among your team, as the software's simplicity makes it straightforward for everyone to use effectively. 04 About us justcourts.eu was developed by a team of aviation attorneys in order to offer airline clients an easy and encompassing tool for their court case management alongside of the platform justclaims.eu – the fully automated solution for pre-trial passenger claims handling processes. Ulrich Steppler , LL.M., is co-founder of the CHS Claims Handling Solutions GmbH and partner of the law firm ARNECKE SIBETH DABELSTEIN where he co-heads the airline & aviation group out of the Frankfurt office. He specializes in aviation matters with a particular focus on passenger air transportation and has been representing numerous air carriers in Germany, including thousands of passenger claims. Katja H. Brecke , LL.M. (Leiden), is co-founder of the CHS Claims Handling Solutions GmbH and partner of the law firm ARNECKE SIBETH DABELSTEIN based in Frankfurt. She has been involved in numerous aviation related matters and has extensive experience in representing passenger airlines and supporting them throughout the claims handling process. Request a Demo Privacy Policy 1. Subject matter of this privacy statement ​ We appreciate your interest in our website and our offers on our websites (hereafter referred to as “justcourts ”) ​ Our main aim is the protection of your personal data (hereafter referred to as “data”). In the following we would like to inform you in detail about what data are collected during your visit to our website and the use of our offers and how we process or use the data hereafter, as well as which accompanying protective measures we have taken in technical and organizational terms. ​ 2. Responsible body/ service provider ​ Responsible body in terms of the Federal Data Protection Act (BDSG) and at the same time service provider in terms of the Telemedia Act (TMG) is ​ CHS Claims Handling Solutions GmbH Güterplatz 1 60327 Frankfurt am Main T +49 69 380 299 910 E info@claims-handling.com ​ Managing directors: Ulrich Steppler Katja H. Brecke ​ The CHS Claims Handling Solutions GmbH is registered in the commercial register of the Frankfurt am Main Local Court under HRB 108923. ​ If you have any questions or comments about this privacy statement or about data protection in general, please send them to the following e-mail address info@claims-handling.com . ​ 3. Collection and use of data ​ At the moment you can only use our website for informational purposes. For the in-formational use of our website, it is not necessary for you to provide data. In this case, we only collect and use the data that your internet browser automatically transmits to us, such as for example: ​ date and time of access to one of our websites our browser type the browser settings the operated system used your last visited page the amount of data transferred and the access status (file transferred, file not found, etc.) as well as your IP-address. ​ We collect and use this data during an informational visit exclusively in a non-personalized form. This is done in order to enable the use of the websites you have accessed, for statistic purposes and to improve our internet offer. The IP-address is only stored for the duration of your visit, no person-related analysis takes place. ​ 4. Use of cookies ​ We use the technology of cookies for our website. Cookies are small text files that are sent to your browser by our web server during your visit to our website, who stores it on your computer for later retrieval. ​ We only use so-called session cookies (also referred to as temporary cookies), i.e. those that are only stored temporarily for the duration of your use of one of our web-sites. The purpose of those cookies is the continuous identification of your computer during your visit to one of our websites and the switch to another of our websites and to ascertain the end of your visit. ​ The cookies are deleted as soon as you end your browser session. ​ Whether cookies can be set and retrieved can be determined by the settings in your browser. For example, you can completely deactivate the storage of cookies in your browser, restrict it to certain web pages or configure your browser in such a way that it automatically notifies you, as soon as a cookie is to be set and asks you for a response. However, for technical reasons, it is necessary to allow session cookies on behalf of the functionality of our website. ​ We do not collect or store personal data in cookies in this context. ​ 5. Data security ​ We also use technical and organizational security measures to protect the incoming or collected personal data, in particular against accidental or intentional manipulation, loss, destruction or against the attack of unauthorized persons. Our security measures are continuously improved in line with technological developments.
